h1: Popups, side panels and options pages that fit
overview: A popup, a side panel and an options page all behave differently, so each needs its own layout. We design and build these surfaces for your extension so they open quickly, sit well in the browser and read clearly at small sizes. We handle sizing, scrolling, keyboard use and saved state, and we connect each screen to your existing logic. You receive working screens and the files behind them.

faq: Chrome and Edge both support them on current versions. Where a browser does not, we fall back to a popup so the feature still works. We confirm this against your target browsers first.
Can you build these on an extension I already have?
Yes. We add the new surfaces to your current code and connect them to the logic you already run. We read the code first and agree the plan in writing.
Yes, browsers cap popup width and height, so we design within those limits and move longer content to a side panel or options page, where space is larger.
We use plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript or a small framework such as React, whichever matches your project. We avoid adding heavy libraries that slow the popup.
